name: postking-mcp

tools.name: login_start
tools.description: Start the PostKing login flow. Returns a URL and short code for the user to visit in their browser. IMPORTANT: Immediately after this tool returns, show the URL + code to the user and then call `login_complete` — it will wait (polling in the background) until the user approves the request in their browser, so there is no need to ask the user to tell you when they are done.

tools.name: login_complete
tools.description: Wait for the user to approve the PostKing login code in their browser and then save the token. Polls automatically; call this immediately after `login_start`.

tools.name: logout
tools.description: Clear locally stored PostKing credentials.

tools.name: whoami
tools.description: Return the profile of the currently authenticated PostKing user (email, plan, credit balance).

tools.name: list_brands
tools.description: List all brands on your PostKing account. Call this first to discover brandIds.

tools.name: set_active_brand
tools.description: Set the active brand for this session. All subsequent tools will use this brand by default.

brandId.description: The brand ID to activate

tools.name: get_brand_info
tools.description: Get the full profile of a brand — tone, audience, themes, social accounts, and more.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: create_brand
tools.description: STEP 1 of brand onboarding (manual path — no website crawl). Creates a new brand from user-supplied name/description, sets it as active, then RETURNS a `nextStep` payload telling you to ask the user which platforms they publish on. After the user answers, call `set_brand_mediums` with their picks. Ask the user for a description if they did not provide one — onboarding will fail without it.

tools.name: onboard_brand
tools.description: STEP 1 of brand onboarding (website path). Crawls the site in the background and kicks off audience analysis + 10 themes. Sets the new brand as active and RETURNS a `nextStep` payload. IMMEDIATELY after this returns, ask the user which social platforms they publish on, then call `set_brand_mediums`. Do not call `get_onboarding_status` until mediums are set.

websiteUrl.description: The website to crawl and analyze

name.description: Brand name (inferred from site if omitted)

tools.name: set_brand_mediums
tools.description: STEP 2 of brand onboarding. Saves the list of platforms the brand publishes on. Call this immediately after `create_brand` or `onboard_brand` and the user has picked platforms. After this, call `get_onboarding_status` every ~15 seconds until it reports `done`.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: get_onboarding_status
tools.description: STEP 3 of brand onboarding. Polls the background analysis + theme generation. Returns one of: `pending`, `processing`, `done`, `failed`. Poll every ~15s. When `done`, onboarding is complete — surface the audience review + themes to the user.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: list_themes
tools.description: List all content themes for the active brand with their IDs.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: edit_theme
tools.description: Edit an existing content theme's title or content instructions.

content.description: New content instructions for the theme

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: delete_theme
tools.description: Delete a content theme from the active brand.

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: generate_themes
tools.description: Generate new content themes using AI. Polls until complete. Deducts credits.

instructions.description: Custom instructions, e.g. 'Focus on startup growth'

input.description: Source text or file path to derive themes from

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: generate_post
tools.description: Generate AI content for a platform. Polls until complete. Deducts 10 credits per variation. After generating, use create_post to save it, then approve_post to schedule it. To repurpose: call repurpose_content first, then create_post with the result, then approve_post.

platform.description: Platform: x | linkedin | instagram | threads | facebook | custom:<charLimit>

theme.description: Theme ID or name (random theme used if omitted)

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.description: Generate and schedule multiple posts across a date range in the background.

platform.description: Platform: x | linkedin | instagram | threads | facebook

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: create_post
tools.description: Save a post draft with custom content to one or more platforms. Supported platforms: x, linkedin, instagram, threads, facebook. After creating, call approve_post with a future ISO 8601 datetime to schedule it. To check which platforms are connected first, call check_social_accounts.

platforms.description: One or more platforms: x | linkedin | instagram | threads | facebook

scheduledAt.description: ISO 8601 UTC datetime to schedule immediately on save, e.g. 2026-03-11T09:00:00Z

brandId.description: Brand ID (uses active brand if omitted)

tools.name: approve_post

tools.name: reschedule_post

tools.name: schedule_post
tools.description: Schedule a draft or approved post for a specific time. Equivalent to approve_post but named to match 'pking posts schedule'. Pass a future ISO 8601 UTC datetime. After scheduling the post status becomes 'scheduled'.

tools.name: cancel_post
tools.description: Cancel a scheduled or approved post, reverting it to draft status without deleting it. Use delete_post to remove it entirely.

tools.name: delete_post
tools.description: Cancel and delete a post regardless of its current status (draft, scheduled, or posted).

tools.name: repurpose_content

IMPORTANT: When the source is a URL, pass it directly to this tool via sourceUrl — do NOT fetch or crawl the URL yourself first. PostKing handles all crawling internally. Source types: url | text | blog | social_post. Target types: social (LinkedIn, X, etc.) | blog | text.

sourceType.description: Where the source content comes from

angle.description: Specific angle or focus, e.g. 'focus on ROI data'

textLength.description: For text target: short | medium | long | custom:<words>

voiceProfileIds.description: Voice profile IDs. Single ID applies to all platforms: ['clxvoice1']. Per-platform: ['x:clxvoice1','linkedin:clxvoice2']. Get IDs from list_voices.
